summary: Verified all 4 features for ClauseGuard iteration 13. All features are working correctly: 1) Clause Detail page displays formatted text with proper indentation for (a), (1), (i), (A) patterns using ListL1/ListL2/ListL3 classes and inline padding-left styles, 2) PDF export shows proper indentation for list items with hanging indent styles and centered (End of clause) marker, 3) Search page has a working Clear button that resets the search input, removes results, and clears URL params, 4) Search results display correctly with clause cards showing FAR/DFARS type badges.

features_verified_this_iteration.feature: Clause Detail page displays formatted text with proper indentation
features_verified_this_iteration.verification: The /api/clauses/formatted/{clause_number} endpoint returns HTML with: 176 paragraphs with padding-left styles, ListL1 (22 elements), ListL2 (23 elements), ListL3 (22 elements) classes. Indentation levels: 1.6em for (a), 3.1em for (1), 4.6em for (i). Text is NOT block text - has proper paragraph structure.

features_verified_this_iteration.feature: PDF export shows proper indentation for list items
features_verified_this_iteration.verification: PDF export uses indent_styles with leftIndent and firstLineIndent (hanging indent). _extract_pdf_paragraphs_from_dita() detects indentation levels from (a), (1), (i), (A) patterns. PDF text shows hierarchical structure with proper indentation.

features_verified_this_iteration.feature: PDF export has centered (End of clause) marker
features_verified_this_iteration.verification: _extract_pdf_paragraphs_from_dita() checks for 'text-align:center' in style OR text content matching '(end of clause)' or '(end of provision)'. centered_style with TA_CENTER alignment is applied. Verified in PDF output.

Clear button (data-testid='clear-search-btn') is visible when query or results exist. Clicking it: resets search input to empty, removes all results, clears URL query params. Tested with 'cybersecurity' query.

features_verified_this_iteration.feature: Search results display with type badges
features_verified_this_iteration.verification: Search results show clause cards with FAR (blue) and DFARS (purple) type badges. Badges use bg-blue-100/bg-purple-100 classes. 'Flowdown Required' badge also displays correctly.
